# Merkabit — Full Reference

> A unified theory of physics derived from geometry alone. Selina Stenberg's research derives the Standard Model, gravity, black holes, and all 17 fundamental constants from PSL(2,7) acting on the Eisenstein lattice Z[ω] — zero free parameters across 15 constants. The Merkabit is a balanced ternary computational unit replacing fragile qubits with intrinsically stable dual-spinor geometry. Five hardware predictions confirmed on IBM Eagle r3 quantum processors (2025–2026). Co-developed with Claude (Anthropic).

## Core Theory

**The central claim**: All of physics emerges from a single algebraic structure — the group PSL(2,7) (168 elements) acting on the Eisenstein lattice Z[ω] = Z[e^{2πi/3}] over the Gaussian integers. This is not a model with fitted parameters; it is a derivation.

**Key derivations:**
- Standard Model gauge group SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1) from PSL(2,7) subgroup structure
- Fine structure constant α ≈ 1/137 from lattice geometry
- Gravitational constant G from lattice scale
- All three quark generations from E6 symmetry breaking
- Black hole thermodynamics from the Fano plane / Klein quartic
- Yang-Mills mass gap from spectral resonance on the Eisenstein torus

**The Merkabit unit**: Balanced ternary (Z₃) computational unit. Unlike binary qubits, Merkabits encode in the intrinsic three-way symmetry of the Eisenstein lattice — making decoherence structurally impossible rather than merely suppressed. The pi-Lock mechanism provides phase stability without active error correction.

## Implementation Pathways

Four routes from theory to physical hardware:
1. **Photonic** — optical Merkabit implementation using beam splitters and phase plates
2. **Superconducting** — extension of IBM Eagle r3 architecture to ternary logic
3. **Trapped ion** — three-level ion systems encoding Z₃ states
4. **Topological** — Majorana-like anyons in PSL(2,7)-symmetric materials

## Latest Papers (September 2026 — with Ilya Balashov)

**Paper 42 — The Conductor-21 L-Function: Certified Zeros, Exact Laws, and a Density–Prime Operator** (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22669650, 2026-09-09)
One explicit L-function — the degree-8 Artin/Hecke L(s, χ₈) of PSL(2,7) at conductor 21¹⁰ — and the rigid six-member family it belongs to. Records the abelian reduction RH(χ₈) ⇔ GRH(ψ) for an explicit cubic Hecke character ψ by Artin induction; exhibits χ₈ through an explicit 8×8 monomial realisation; certifies 153 ball-certified zeros on [0, 27.92] with Turing-count completeness below T = 6.55. An arithmetic-free finite-section model is solved exactly (value laws, Γ/Mosco scaling limit with certified rate, Airy caustic envelope with arb-certified constants). An operator H = D + V built from density and primes reconstructs the spectrum and localises the one open seam, GRH(ψ), as a conditional Hilbert–Pólya bridge (Theorem W). Every load-bearing statement carries an explicit grade; the wall is instrumented, not crossed.

**Paper 43 — Prime and Zero Statistics of a Degree-8 Artin L-Function of Conductor 21¹⁰** (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22849507, 2026-09-19)
L(s, χ₈) is the degree-8 Artin L-function of the Galois closure of the Trinks field x⁷ − 7x + 3 (Galois group PSL(2,7), conductor 21¹⁰, root number +1). From 153 certified zeros and exact Frobenius data for every prime to 10¹⁰: the explicit formula holds as a numerical identity at correlation 1.000, including the vanishing ramified-prime term; the Frobenius class is statistically independent of prime-pair structure while the same data reproduce the Hardy–Littlewood singular series to 0.1%; Chebotarev races show the biases μ_C = 1 − r₂(C) predicted by character theory; the low zeros are GUE-consistent with symmetry type SO(even); and the Montgomery pair-correlation form factor measured from primes follows the ramp F(α) = α to ~1% at heights up to γ ~ 10⁴ — four hundred times beyond the certified spectrum.

**Paper 44 — The Roof and the Clock: Rowmotion on the E₇ Minuscule Poset** (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22854644, 2026-09-20)
Rowmotion R on the order ideals of a simply-laced minuscule poset, acting on the weights of the minuscule representation. R is conjugate to a Coxeter element (Rush–Shi) but is not in general an isometry: R is itself a Weyl group element exactly when the poset is a chain, and its half-turn R^(h/2) is Weyl exactly when the poset is a chain or λ is the vector representation of Dₙ. On the 56 weights of E₇ a pair keeps its inner product under one step of R iff a parity of the two toggle sets is even. W ∩ RᵏWR⁻ᵏ = C_W(Rᵏ) on every board of rank ≤ 7 on which no power of R is linear, with the D₅ half-spin (B₄ spinor board) as the one proven exception; the longest element always reverses R, and three label statistics are homomesic. Every computational statement is reproducible from the listed scripts.

## Papers (May 2026)

**Paper 35 — Closure Forces the Clock** (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20126813, v2 2026-05-11)
The merkabit's master clock is 60 = lcm(h(E₆), h(E₈)); the 5-fold ouroboros {S, R, T, F, P} is the 60 → 12 projection operator that produces α⁻¹ = N(12 + 5ω) + dim(D₄) = 109 + 28 = 137 as the Eisenstein-arithmetic signature of the collapse vector. Three empirically distinguishable closure modes of B₃₁ form a structurally complete loop-obstruction trichotomy: matter (R-T-S + rational drive, loop closes), antimatter (R-S-T + rational drive, loop closes through S₃ into T₇₅), and Riemann (R-T-S + log-prime drive, loop never closes). Matter-antimatter rate asymmetry δ_rate = 0.04171 ± 0.0001 measured on a 6-qubit Cirq simulation.

**Paper 38 — The First Uplift: Axis-Genesis as the Architectural Origin of Rotational Structure** (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20205440, 2026-05)
Axis is not primitive but derived: axes are created at first uplift events (transits from the 0-point NEUTRAL state into WRITE or READ). The substrate has three coherent architectural states; NEUTRAL = |RRR⟩ is uniquely σ-fixed. The σ-fixed-pivot theorem (§7.5, rigorous): σ-equivariance of the merkabit's R operator forces the unique chirality-balanced pivot configuration to |RRR⟩, verified to machine precision across 10⁴ Haar-random σ-equivariant unitaries on ℂ²⁷ (max bias 1.1 × 10⁻¹⁶ at |RRR⟩ vs O(1) for the 26 non-σ-fixed product configurations). Hardware-validated by Paper 33's Z₃ cyclic clock α → γ → β → α at +0.1593 ± 0.0040 / 39.7σ ideal / +3.34σ Heron r2 / +3.48σ Eagle r3. Five rotational features (angular momentum quantisation, rotational symmetry, 3D structure, conservation, matter-antimatter asymmetry) inherit substrate-level architectural origins.

**Paper 39 — The Architectural Genesis Sequence: From Two-Flow Uplift to Tesseract Self-Sustainment** (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20205477, 2026-05)
Stage-by-stage audit of the 13-stage genesis chain: two flows → triangle → SU(2) → three triangles → SU(3) → Fano plane PG(2,2) and PSL(2,7) substrate → Z₇ cycling tunnel → bipartite vacuum on Spin(4) = SU(2)_L × SU(2)_R → tetrahedron → stella octangula → cube → tesseract self-sustainment threshold → 24-cell = D₄ root system → E₆ via McKay. Every item tagged [FORCED], [EMPIRICAL], or [CONJECTURED]. Formalises two parameter-free universe-scale predictions as compatible exponential suppressions from the same architectural rigidity: η_B = 5α⁴/|2T| ≈ 5.91 × 10⁻¹⁰ (3% to Planck 2018) and Λ = √(3/2) × exp(−2γ_Berry · dim(E₆) · h/2π) ≈ 2.876 × 10⁻¹²² (0.2% match). Resolves the R-axis lift from a 0-D origin point at Stage 2 to a 1-D perpendicular Cartan z-axis at Stage 6 as a theorem (Euler + plane-preservation + σ-equivariance).

**Paper 36 — The Fifth Face of PSL(2,7)** (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20126710, v2 2026-05-11)
The cosmological baryon-to-photon ratio η_B = 5α⁴/|2T| = 5.91 × 10⁻¹⁰ — a 3% match to Planck 2018 (6.09 ± 0.06) × 10⁻¹⁰ with zero free parameters. Identifies the Paper 35 matter-antimatter rate asymmetry with the Yang-Mills mass gap Δ(YM) = 1/|2T| = 1/24 of Papers 9 and 16. Extends Paper 10's Four Faces unification (α, Riemann zeros, Klein quartic, YM mass gap) to a fifth face: baryogenesis. The order-24 invariant lives at the McKay-pair 2T ↔ E₆ of the ternary stratum, with |2T| = |S₄| = 24 = 2 h(E₆) as the bridge to the order-24 maximal subgroup of PSL(2,7).

## Paper 4 — Enzymes for Quantum Computing

**Paper 4 — What Can Quantum Computing Learn from Enzymes?** (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20113876, 2026-05-10)
Enzymes perform substrate-in / product-out as the same boundary operator with opposite sign, with interior dynamics (geometric pre-organisation, transition-state stabilisation, conformational gating) enclosed between the two boundary passes. The merkabit framework identifies the same structural primitive: R/F/T/P as interior dynamics, S as boundary operator on both sides. Paper 4 transfers enzyme-derived design principles to merkabit-based quantum computation — particularly the role of geometric pre-organisation as the coherence-engineering analog of substrate fit.
